content.thinking: No /usr/bin/time. Let me use bash's time or Python timing.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && for n in worst2 worst8 batch8 batch8b stress_full stress_tight stress_cov; do
  start=$(date +%s.%N)
  python3 public_exec.py /workspace/submission/main.py < /workspace/tmp/$n.json > /workspace/tmp/$n.out2 2>/workspace/tmp/$n.err; code=$?
  end=$(date +%s.%N)
  echo "$n exit=$code time=$(python3 -c "print('%.2f'%($end-$start))") size=$(stat -c%s /workspace/tmp/$n.out2) err=$(stat -c%s /workspace/tmp/$n.err)"
done
